process.lede: Four steps, from the first message to the day itself.

steps.title: Tell us about the person
steps.body: Their passions, what they dislike, meaningful memories: everything that helps us build a truly bespoke day.

steps.title: We build the day
steps.body: Hour by hour, we bring together the right providers, with clear price options, never a surprise.

steps.title: You approve
steps.body: We adjust live with you until it's exactly right, no more, no less.

steps.title: We take care of everything
steps.body: Bookings, coordination on the day: all you have to do is enjoy the moment with them.

paragraphs: It all started one evening, at 11:47pm.
We were among friends around a table. We knew exactly who we wanted to treat, we had a budget, ideas galore… but not the faintest idea how to turn all that into an actual day.
So we looked for someone to do it for us.
We contacted agencies, looked at gift boxes, activities, experiences… But every time, it was the same thing: we were offered ready-made packages where you had to pick from a list.
We didn't want to pick an activity.
We wanted to start from this person and build their day around them.

So we ended up organizing everything ourselves. We designed the whole route, booked the different venues, prepared the surprises, and even brought their loved ones into the plan. Some had to play along, show up at just the right moment, or play a part without them suspecting a thing.
And on the day itself, it all came to life.
We saw the surprise, the laughter, the emotion… and we realized we'd just created something different.
Not just an activity. An entire story to live through.
That's when we thought: what if we did this for other people too?
Today, our idea stays the same: you give us the person, the occasion, and your budget. We imagine everything else.
Because some memories deserve to be created entirely from scratch.
story.transition: The two faces behind every day

bios.leo: Makes sure to understand exactly what you have in mind, before even talking about providers.
bios.luca: Builds the day and negotiates every detail so it all comes together, from budget to the big day.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Every day is different, so every budget is too. We always build the day around the starting budget you give us, never the other way around.

items.question: How far in advance should I contact you?
items.answer: As early as possible for maximum options, but we've put together projects in just a few days. Tell us your timeline and we'll tell you honestly what's possible.

items.question: Where do you operate?
items.answer: We currently operate in Paris and its surrounding area (Île-de-France). Tell us where you are and we'll quickly confirm if it's possible.

items.question: What if we're a group (bachelor/bachelorette party)?
items.answer: No problem: we always separate the person being celebrated from the group living the day, so the logistics (meals, transport, activities) are costed accurately, either per head or as a flat rate, whichever makes sense.

items.question: Is it really bespoke, or a disguised package?
items.answer: Truly bespoke. We don't work with fixed packages: if you want 8 activities in the day, we build 8 activities.
